name: Readiness → Plan → Approve → Execute → Review
description: Workflow template, not an authorization implementation. The host runner must enforce read-only discovery, authorized approval of current evidence, and reapproval on every retry. See docs/workflow-contracts.md.

stages.name: Readiness discovery
stages.prompt:
## CONTEXT RESET
Evaluate {{story_title}} for {{project_name}} at {{source_url}}. This stage is read-only: no branch, commit, repository edits or coding session. Follow docs/ai/jira-ai-readiness-scorer.md and src/agents/skills/jira-ai-readiness/SKILL.md. Read current ticket and linked decisions, inspect canonical code, tests and consumers within the rubric's bounds. Identify the state owner, existing models/APIs, snapshot/event/patch semantics and unresolved conflicts. Record ticket timestamp, document versions and actual inspected commits. Classify before scoring; use examples/jira-ai-readiness/bin/score.js for deterministic scoring and fingerprinting, not an invented percentage or hash. Report the evidence, blockers, smallest fixes and result. STOP and escalate missing required evidence. A readiness score is not authorization. On a retry, include review feedback and changed evidence; do not reuse the earlier approval.

stages.name: Read-only plan
Human approval before coding
Implement approved plan
Review implementation
stages.prompt:
## CONTEXT RESET
Review {{pr_url}} for {{story_title}} in {{project_name}}. Verify acceptance criteria {{acceptance_criteria}}, approved plan/evidence, state ownership, data semantics, consumers and regression tests. Distinguish actual persisted-data coverage from mocked calls. Check security, compatibility and repository style. Do not invent successful checks. Output JSON only: {"verdict": "approve|bounce|escalate", "summary": "assessment", "issues": [{"severity": "MUST_FIX|OPTIONAL", "file": "path", "issue": "description", "fix": "action"}]}. A bounce returns to readiness and human approval before further coding. This review verdict is advisory; it is not permission to merge.

stages.name: Draft ready for human review
